metas.name: ★ 9.3 · 2019 · Chernobyl
metas.description: In April 1986, the city of Chernobyl in the Soviet Union suffers one of the worst nuclear disasters in the history of mankind. Consequently, many heroes put their lives on the line in the following days, weeks and months.

metas.name: ★ 9.2 · 1973 · The World at War
metas.description: A groundbreaking 26-part documentary series narrated by the actor Laurence Olivier about the deadliest conflict in history, World War II.

metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2021 · The Beatles: Get Back
metas.description: In January 1969, The Beatles set out to write and record new songs for their first live show in more than two years, culminating in an impromptu concert atop their Savile Row studio.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2016 · The Crown
metas.description: Follows the political rivalries and romances of Queen Elizabeth II's reign and the events that shaped Britain for the second half of the 20th century.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2012 · Call the Midwife
metas.description: Chronicles the lives of a group of midwives living in East London in the late 1950s to the early 1970s.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2015 · The Last Kingdom
metas.description: As Alfred the Great defends his kingdom from Norse invaders, Uhtred--born a Saxon but raised by Vikings--seeks to claim his ancestral birthright.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1977 · Jesus of Nazareth
metas.description: Beginning before the Nativity and extending through the Crucifixion and Resurrection, this mini-series brings to life all of the sweeping drama in the life of Jesus, as told by the Gospels.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1982 · 'Allo 'Allo!
metas.description: In France during World War II, René Artois runs a small café where Resistance fighters, Gestapo men, German Army officers and escaped Allied POWs interact daily, ignorant of one another's true identity or presence, exasperating René.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2016 · Victoria
metas.description: The early life of Queen Victoria, from her ascension to the throne at the tender age of 18 to her courtship and marriage to Prince Albert.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2007 · The Tudors
metas.description: Epic series reveals the scandalous life of a young king whose affairs and obsession with producing a male heir changed marriage, the church, and the world.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2016 · War & Peace
metas.description: As the Russian conflict with Napoleon reaches its peak, five aristocratic families face the possibility of their lives being changed forever.
